title: Member checks
description: data/checks.json -- every member check of the project as the export writes it, read by lib/timber.typ (#show-check-member, #check-member-ids; docs/domain/member-checks.md §3.3undecies, §3.3unvicies). One record per Woodcore-Datei/checks/<id>.json, its followed values resolved against the positions of the same export. A check that cannot be calculated is exported all the same, with `calculable: false` and its reason, and the report refuses it with that reason (the v0.33 rule).

schema_version.description: -- 1.0, or 1.1 where a record carries `links`, or 1.2 where a record carries `fire` (issue #46): an export written at another version is refused rather than read as this one. 1.3 where a record carries `vars` and `gen`, a check printed unfolded (spec 2026-10-15-calculs-deplies-balises-figures-natives, ARCH-007). 1.4 where such a record carries `file`, the file of its domain (issue #64). 1.5 where a record's `fire` carries `required`, the citation of a duration VKF 15-15 requires (spec 2026-10-20-indices-et-niveaux, REQ-001); 1.5 holds everything 1.4 does. 1.6 where a check is printed unfolded, with its `vars` and its `file` and without `gen`, the form being the regeneration base's alone (spec 2026-10-21-commandes-typst-refonte, ARCH-011); 1.6 holds everything 1.5 does but `gen`. 1.7 where a record carries the material of the library (issue #112, spec 2026-10-24-verifications-elements-v3, REQ-015): `material`, a panel's `loading`, `kled`, `accidental`, the `resistance` the export froze, `reason_code` and `reason_params`, `notes`, `display`; 1.7 holds everything 1.6 does.

checks.description: One record per check, keyed by its id.

position.description: The position the source names, as it names it.

position_found.description: Whether the export carries that position: #show-check-member reads its line only then.

grade_from.description: Where the value came from: "position", "stated", or null where neither gives one.

section.description: The section the check computes with, resolved, and its text («100/200 mm», «Ø 200 mm»); null where neither the source nor the position gives one.

section_from.description: Where the value came from: "position", "stated", or null where neither gives one.

moisture_from.description: Where the value came from: "position", "stated", or null where neither gives one.

N.description: The design force: a tension's normal force, positive; a compression's magnitude, positive; a bending's normal force signed, tension positive, 0 for none. null for a shear, which reads its shear forces (issue #38).

calculable.description: Whether #show-check-member can print the check; false where something it needs is missing -- `reason` says what.

reason.description: Why it cannot be calculated, "" where it can.

M_y.description: A bending: the design moment about y, a moment of 0 being none (null); absent for the other kinds, whose records stay as they were.

M_z.description: A bending: the design moment about z, null where none; absent for the other kinds.

warnings.description: What the export printed about this check.

material.description: Issue #112, 1.7: the material of the library the source names -- its id, type (member, panel), origin (sia265, sia265-1, user), names {fr, de, en} and where it came from (stated: written over the position). Absent where the check follows its position's strength class.

loading.description: Issue #112, 1.7: a panel's loading {mode: plaque | voile | tc, direction: par | perp}.

kled.description: Issue #112, 1.7: a panel's load-duration class (SIA 265/1 Tableau 7).

accidental.description: Issue #112, 1.7: a panel in an accidental design situation, γ_M = 1,0.

resistance.description: Issue #112, 1.7 (ARCH-008): what the export read of a material that is no class of SIA 265 -- a member of the engineer's own (its design values and how each was had) or a panel (its column, thickness and range, η_mod, γ_M, the values of its loading) --, so that the check computes from the record alone, alike on any computer.

reason_code.description: Issue #112, 1.7: the code of a refusal of the material (member_check_material.Refusal), which the window says in its words; `reason` says it in English.

reason_params.description: Issue #112, 1.7: the numbers of that refusal.

notes.description: Issue #112, 1.7: what is only said, in orange -- a class written over the position's, a panel's thickness not the side its loading supposes: {code, params}.

display.description: Issue #112, 1.7: the options of «Affichage» the source keeps (REQ-010), which the file of the check is written with.

case.description: A compression at an angle: the case of Tabelle 8 or 9 read for f_c,90,d; null for a tension and a compression along the grain.

larger.description: A compression at an angle: whether the bracketed f_c,90,d is read; null where no contact is checked.

l.description: A compression at an angle: the contact length in mm; null otherwise.

w.description: A compression at an angle: the contact width in mm, resolved -- the section's b or the one stated; null otherwise, or where a round section gives none.

w_from.description: Where w came from: "section" (its width b), "stated", or null.

case_label.description: The table's words for the case, «Endauflagerung (grössere Eindrückungen)»; null where no contact is checked.

f_c_90_table.description: f_c,90,d as SIA 265 Tabelle 8 or 9 gives it for the case, in N/mm², before eta_w and eta_t, which the report applies -- read, not computed; null where no contact is checked or the table gives none.

V_z.description: A shear: the design shear force in the plane of h (z), its sign immaterial; absent, null or 0 is none. Optional, additive (issue #38).

V_y.description: A shear: the design shear force in the plane of b (y), likewise. Optional, additive (issue #38).

pith.description: A shear: a member cut from the pith takes half of f_v,d (SIA 265 Tabelle 8 note 6). Optional; absent or null is false (issue #38).

variant.description: A shear: what it checks -- `shear` (SIA 265 4.2.5.1), `shear-off` (4.2.6), `shear-perp` (4.2.7.1) (spec 2026-10-21-commandes-typst-refonte, REQ-021). Optional, additive; absent or null is shear.

F.description: A shear-off: the design force sheared off, a {value, unit} block; l and w its sheared length and width in mm, w null following the member's width (4.2.6). Optional, additive.

sigma_90.description: A shear across the grain: the design stress perpendicular to the grain in N/mm², transverse tension positive (4.2.7.1). Optional, additive.

l_y.description: A buckling, or a lateral torsional buckling with a compression: the system length about y, in mm, 0 or above -- the buckling length is beta_y · l_y, 0 holding the member against buckling about y. Optional, additive (issue #38).

beta_y.description: The buckling length coefficient about y, 0 or above: 1 pinned-pinned, 2 cantilever, 0.7, 0.5; absent or null is 1 (issue #38).

a.description: A lateral torsional buckling: the distance between the lateral supports, in mm, above 0 -- sigma_m,crit by (41); or null with sigma_m_crit given (issue #38).

sigma_m_crit.description: A lateral torsional buckling: the critical bending stress of a finer calculation, in N/mm², above 0, in place of (41) -- never with a (issue #38).

fire.description: A check in the design situation fire, SIA 265 4.5.2 (issue #46), resolved: present only for such a check. `section` stays the section before the fire; `b` and `h` here are the ideal residual section #member(fire:) computes, written for the summary and the window -- the report computes them again from `duration`, `sides` and `wood`, and tests/test_member_check.py holds the two equal.

duration.description: The fire resistance checked, in minutes: the check's own, or what VKF 15-15 requires; null where neither gives one (the check is then not calculable).

requirement.description: What VKF 15-15 requires for the project's building and this check (calc/norms/vkf.py, required_resistance): {minutes, table, page, row, base, notes, reason, norm, norm_ref}; null where the project states no building.

required.description: The citation of the duration where VKF 15-15 requires it (`duration_from` «vkf»): {norm, norm_ref} -- «VKF 15-15», «Tabelle 2» --, composed once by the export and copied by #show-check-member into #member's `fire: (required:)`, so that the row t_fi cites it in the window and in the report (spec 2026-10-20-indices-et-niveaux, REQ-001); null or absent where the engineer states the duration, which cites SIA 265 4.5.2.

sides.description: The faces the fire reaches, in this order.

wood.description: The wood Tabelle 13 is read for: softwood, beech, oak or cladding; null where it cannot be read.

links.description: Where each value that follows a variable came from (REQ-012), by its key in the source: the variable, the factor and offset it was taken with, its own value and unit, and `stale` where it could not be read and the source's last value was kept. Absent where no field follows one.

variable.description: A variable of the export this field follows (calc/domains/links.py, spec 2026-10-11-variables-liees-champs-et-textes D-17): the pair a call names its calculation by and its key -- a domain of the «Formule» tab carries origin "formulas" and its id as instance --, with an optional factor and offset (factor × variable + offset).

vars.description: A check printed unfolded (calc/domains/unfold.py): the values its literals are checked against by `#var(key, value, domain: ("check", id))` -- the section's sides, the inputs of `member_check.compute` (force, angle, eta_w, eta_t) and the values of SIA 265 Tabelle 8/9 its design values are computed from -- each a var of the export.

file.description: A check printed unfolded (1.4, issue #64): the file of its domain from the Typst root, `/Timber-checks/Tension/<id>.typ` -- what #show-check-member includes -- or null where the file is still the stub that prints it folded, or one the engineer wrote in.

gen.description: A check printed unfolded, from 1.3 to 1.5: the form it is written from -- its kind, the equation of SIA 265 its verdict follows, and the version of the writer. Not written since 1.6: the form is the regeneration base's (calc/domains/unfold.py).
